card.name: Catholic Church encyclopedia passage words
card.fires_on: Words inside one memorized-style passage about the Catholic Church's global influence (central figure, influence, extend, part of the globe). Also fires weakly on a few words in other formal prose.

modes.label: Church history passage
modes.description: Words in the sentence describing the Catholic Church as a central figure whose influence extends to every part of the globe.
